pr_title: Fix editor crash when expanding/collapsing empty scene tree
pr_body:
Fixes #55523

The scene tree dock performs an additional check to see if the tree contains any children. If not, it just stops.
pr_comments: Thanks! And congrats for your first merged Godot contribution :tada:
